page.overview:
Who is Agon?

Agon is the daimon or god of contests — part of Greek mythology.

He had an altar in Olympia, the location of the Olympic Games. He may have been the same as Zelos, the god of rivalry.

In Greek mythology, Agon sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
